paths.label: shown
paths.quote: count++ adds 2 to count each time; so count ends at 4 and it prints 4
paths.logic: Folk meaning: '++' reads as 'plus plus' (add twice) or as a maths symbol with no effect, and i++ inside an expression is read as 'add 1 at some later time'. In Java i++ and ++i each add exactly 1 to i immediately when evaluated; they differ only in the value the expression yields.

paths.label: correct
paths.logic: A loop prints the same thing on every pass; the changing loop variable does not affect what the body does.
paths.twin_logic: The body uses the current value of the loop variable, so its output can differ on each pass.
